name: fxm_colsave3
doc: Stands in for saves/field_re/colsave3.srm (the battery after tools/menu_audit_cmp.py's owsavecol drive on the 1000 A.D. overworld): X, R x3 to Config, A, Down, Right to cell 6, A, Right x3 to window colour 3, B, B, R x2 to Save, A (the save screen), A on the empty slot 1 (saved), B, B. The cart RAM (the CTLS payload's last 8192 bytes) then holds slot 1 in colour 3 ($0591 = A3) with signature E41B.
